name: Adamant Mint
description: Can be smelled. It ups Attack, but reduces Sp. Atk.

gifts.note: Automatic at the start. When you set the wall clock in your bedroom at the start of a new game, you also receive an Adamant Mint, a Modest Mint, a Jolly Mint and a Timid Mint. No message mentions them; check the Bag. Setting the clock is required, so they can't be missed.
